subject: Preflight: 48h concurrency spike for FinBridge POC — request extra sandbox funding
messages:
From: Stuart Hayes <stuart.hayes@finbridge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Preflight: 48h concurrency spike for FinBridge POC — request extra sandbox funding

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. We have a tight preflight window next week where we'll run a 48-hour concurrency spike to validate 95th-percentile latency under production-like traffic. Preliminary numbers: 150 RPS sustained, peak bursts to 350 RPS, average prompt+response ~1.2k tokens, estimated total tokens ~1.8M over 48h.

We need a safety buffer for the sandbox so our SREs can run soak and failover tests without throttling. Can Redwood provide an ephemeral top-up for the POC (non-billing, one-time) and increase the concurrency quota for that window? Ideally we'd like confirmation of available headroom by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the test start on Monday 11/08.

Acceptance criteria for us:
- Dedicated test window with up to 200k extra tokens (or equivalent quota)
- Monitoring visibility to token burn and 95th/99th latency during tests
- Expiry of the buffer after the 48h window

If you need more specifics (sample request traces, expected seq lengths), I can share a short traffic template.

Best,
Stuart Hayes
Head of ML Infrastructure
FinBridge

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stuart Hayes <stuart.hayes@finbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: 48h concurrency spike for FinBridge POC — request extra sandbox funding

Hi Stuart — appreciate the details and the quick cadence.

We can support a one-time safety buffer and bump concurrency for the POC window, but need an internal approval and a short credit MOU signed before we provision. To move quickly: would a 200k token top-up work for you (we can scale to 250k with ops sign-off)? Please confirm the exact start/end timestamps (your local timezone) and whether you want the load routed through our dedicated POC pool (recommended for stable 95th pctl numbers).

I'll loop in Karthik to size the performance estimate and Marissa to sign off on the one-off credit. I'll attach our preflight checklist and the lightweight credit authorization form for signature.

Attachments: preflight-checklist.pdf (preflight steps), credit-MOU.docx (short form)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T15:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: 48h concurrency spike for FinBridge POC — recommendation

Tessa / Marissa,

Quick sizing note after looking at Stuart's numbers: 150 RPS sustained with peaks to 350 and ~1.2k tokens per request -> rough token burn is ~2M over 48h. For safety and to avoid throttling during peak scenarios, recommend provisioning 200k tokens as a top-up and toggling the workload to our POC-dedicated cluster for that 48h. That should keep 95th pctl latency representative of Dedicated behavior.

Cost exposure for a 200k token top-up at list is trivial for Redwood, but risk is if they extend tests/re-run. Suggest the following conditions:
- One-time top-up, expires 72 hours after the test end if not consumed
- Require signed credit-MOU (short form)
- Limit to endpoints "poc-finbridge-*" and monitor token usage live (ops alert if burn > 220k)

I've attached a quick performance-estimate.xlsx with assumptions and projection curves (very rough).

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: performance-estimate.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-11-04T09:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: 48h concurrency spike for FinBridge POC — approval

Tessa / Karthik,

Approve a one-time 200,000 token top-up for FinBridge (deal FB-49832-POC). Conditions:
- Require signed credit-authorization-form.pdf (I attached a copy)
- Top-up will be ephemeral and expires 72h after the POC window closes
- Note in HubSpot: one-off promotion, do not convert to recurring quota automatically

I'll process the approval and instruct billing to mark it as promotional credit. Tessa — please upload the signed MOU to the HubSpot deal and drop the DocuSign link in the thread so we have an audit trail.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: credit-authorization-form.pdf]

Best,
Tessa Morgan

Redwood Inference
